description: Read the global weather forecast accuracy leaderboard (MAE, RMSE, circular angular error for wind_direction including >3 m/s active-wind curves, and categorical rain skill HSS, POD, FAR, CSI across lead days 0..7) or country-level published H3 cell-win summaries across all 45 forecast models and 8,927 stations. All 45 FACT models (2025 archive, 2025-02-13 to 2025-12-31, QoD >= 0.80 station-days): WeatherXM MOSAIC (MOSAIC), meteoblue (METEOBLUE), meteoblue station-mLM (commissioned) (mLM), ECMWF IFS (IFS025, IFSHRES), ECMWF AIFS AI (AIFS025), NOAA GFS 0.5° (GFS05), NOAA HRRR (HRRR), NOAA National Blend of Models (NBM), NOAA NAM (NAM3, NAM5, NAM12, NAMAK), DWD ICON (ICON, ICONEU, ICOND2), UK Met Office (UMGLOBAL10, UKMO2), ECCC GEM (GEM15, GEM2), Meteo-France ARPEGE/AROME (MFGLOBAL, MFEU, MFFR), COSMO (COSMOI2, COSMOM5), HARMONIE-AROME (HARMONIE), JMA MSM (MSM), WRF (WRFGR, WRFAMS), meteoblue NEMS/NMM (NEMSGLOBAL, NEMSGLOBAL_E, NEMS4, NEMS12, NEMS12_E, NEMSAF01, NEMSAS02, NEMSCAM, NEMSIN, NEMSNZ, NEMSSA, NMM4, NMM22), regional models (AF01, AS01, SA01). GFS025 is not archived; requests for it resolve to GFS05 with a resolution warning. Country counts describe published cell wins, not national matched-sample accuracy.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked models to return (1..45, default 45 for full model universe).

name: get_fact_leaderboard
